usage: The word 刀 (dou1) is a noun used to refer to a knife, a tool with a blade commonly used in the kitchen and dining.
It can be used to specify different types of knives by adding adjectives before 刀, such as 廚刀 (chui4 dou1) meaning kitchen knife.
In a sentence, 刀 can act as the object of a verb, for example, 我用刀切菜 (I use a knife to cut vegetables).
It is common to use 刀 together with other kitchen utensils to talk about food preparation or dining.
The measure word for 刀 depends on the context, but commonly 一把刀 (jat1 baa2 dou1) is used to count knives.
